sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time (UTC): 2026-10-30 02:58 UTC | Scope: Weekly | Date range: 2026-10-23 through 2026-10-30 | Ranking basis: Weekly GitHub Trending star gains; one newly created repository is appended as a clearly marked Search API supplement.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: The strongest signal is the agent workflow layer: security auditing, interface design and structured coding workflows lead the weekly gains, while domain-specific agents are spreading into trading, SEO and presentation work. Cloudflare’s security-audit-skill tops the captured Trending view with 14,320 stars gained.

Supporting repositories: 01-cloudflare-security-audit-skill, 03-tauricresearch-tradingagents, 05-obra-superpowers, 08-agricidaniel-claude-seo, 10-ruvnet-ruflo.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: GitHub’s weekly breakout is increasingly about making agents reliable and useful inside concrete workflows: security findings, code changes and visual interfaces are being organized through skills, specialized roles and deterministic checks. The same pattern is expanding into professional tasks, while PHP’s appearance is a reminder that conventional core software still attracts attention.
